definitions: A covering for the head and neck, often attached to a coat or jacket.
The metal covering over the engine of a car.
A protective covering placed over a cooker to extract steam and smells.
A member of a street gang.
A distinctive covering worn over an academic gown, indicating the wearer's degree and university.
examples: She pulled her hood up against the rain.
He lifted the car hood to check the engine.
The kitchen has a new extractor hood.
The hoods were causing trouble in the neighbourhood.
The professor wore his ceremonial hood.
